amends: direction_ternary_v1_20261013: preflight stopped before any historical estimator fit; make strict boundary convention explicit without mutating frozen v1
boundary_convention: Keep the parent time sample, then exclude labels ending exactly at either purge cutoff. No outcomes or performance were used for this correction.
adaptive_band: per-symbol median absolute percentage return, using only the same causal sampled fitting rows as the model
label_rule: down if return_pct < -band_pct; neutral if abs(return_pct) <= band_pct; up if return_pct > band_pct
units: percentage points: 0.25 means 0.25 percent, not 0.25 as a fraction or 0.25 bps
model: three-class LogisticRegression, pooled across the same 8 assets as the binary parent
sparse_class_policy: No estimator fit. Use smoothed per-asset train priors; disclose fallback and directional support.

primary_bootstrap.family: accuracy and macro-F1 versus all 7 controls, all 8 assets and 4 horizons together: 448 cells

fixed_band_reporting: descriptive sensitivity only; no best-test-threshold selection
